chunks.text: Welcome to the Slow English podcast.
In this podcast, we speak slow and easy English.
Today we talk about a very special and less known place.
The place is Ait Ben Hadou.
Ait Ben Hadou is in Morocco.
Morocco is a country in North Africa.
It is a small village made of clay buildings.
Part two, Ait Ben Hadou is very old.
It is more than 500 years old.
Long ago, it was an important stop for traders.
People traveled with goods like salt, gold, and spices.
Part three, the village is built with clay and mud.
The buildings are brown and look natural.
They match the color of the land.
This makes the village very unique.
Part four, Ait Ben Hadou is on a hill.
The houses go up the hill step by step.
At the top, there is a great view.
Visitors can see the desert and the river.
Part five, there is a small river near the village.
People cross the river to enter the village.
Sometimes they walk on stones.
Sometimes they use a small bridge.
Part six, Ait Ben Hadou is a UNESCO World Heritage site.
This means it is important for world culture.
Many visitors come to see its history and beauty.
Part seven, the village is very quiet.
Not many people live there today.
Some families still live in the old houses.
Life is simple and traditional.
Part eight, many movies were filmed in Ait Ben Hadou.
The village looks like a movie set.
It is perfect for historical films.
Visitors enjoy seeing this place.
Part nine, the weather in Ait Ben Hadou is hot and dry.
It is near the desert.
In summer, it can be very hot.
People wear light clothes and drink water often.
Part 10, local people sell handmade items.
They sell carpets, jewelry, and art.
These items are made by hand.
Visitors like to buy souvenirs.
Part 11, sunset in Ait Ben Hadou is very beautiful.
The clay buildings become orange and gold.
The sky changes color.
It is a peaceful and magical moment.
Part 12, Ait Ben Hadou is a small place with great history.
The clay houses, quiet streets, and desert views make it special.
Visitors can feel the past and enjoy nature.
